Scriptsuft placeholder runtime
-- scriptsuft_basic.asm (source) --
; scriptsuft_basic.asm
; x86-64 Linux NASM
; Equivalent to the basic Scriptsuft examples from docs/part1/BASICS.md

global _start

section .data
    hello db "Hello World", 10
    hello_len equ $-hello

    name db "John", 10
    name_len equ $-name

section .text

_start:
    ; speak("Hello World")
    lea rsi, [rel hello]
    mov rdx, hello_len
    call print_line

    ; def(static) var{"name"} res{"John"}
    ; speak var(name)
    lea rsi, [rel name]
    mov rdx, name_len
    call print_line

    ; loop-limit(5)
    mov rcx, 5

.loop:
    ; while loop is running:
    lea rsi, [rel hello]
    mov rdx, hello_len
    call print_line

    dec rcx
    jnz .loop

    ; exit
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

print_line:
    ; rsi = pointer to string
    ; rdx = length
    mov rax, 1      ; sys_write
    mov rdi, 1      ; stdout
    syscall
    ret
